content.name: Mathieu Gagnon
content.title: Art Director and Senior Graphic Designer
content.summary: Bilingual art director and senior graphic designer with 15 years in packaging, retail and brand design in Montréal. Leads a studio of six, manages a $650,000 annual production budget and redesigned a grocery private-label range of 240 products that lifted category sales by 11%.

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Designed posters, programmes and catalogues for cultural clients, including several Montréal festivals, in French and English.
Managed print jobs from proof to press check with three local printers, keeping colour consistent across runs.
Built a bilingual typesetting template that halved the time needed to adapt layouts between French and English.

experience.title: Senior Graphic Designer
bullets: Designed packaging and dielines for food and personal-care brands sold across Canada.
Checked every label for bilingual requirements under the Consumer Packaging and Labelling Act and Québec's Charter of the French Language.
Cut artwork errors returned by printers from about 8% of jobs to under 2% by introducing a two-step proof sign-off.
Trained two junior designers in prepress and colour management.

experience.title: Art Director
bullets: Lead a team of six designers and production artists across packaging, retail and campaign work for 12 retained clients.
Directed the redesign of a regional grocer's private-label range of 240 products, followed by an 11% rise in category sales.
Manage a $650,000 annual print and production budget and negotiate rates with photographers, illustrators and printers.
Introduced a shared design system and asset library that reduced time-to-shelf for line extensions by about three weeks.
Present creative strategy to client marketing directors and pitch for new business, winning 5 of 8 pitches since 2022.

education.degree: DEC in Graphic Design (Diplôme d'études collégiales)

achievements.title: Packaging design award
achievements.detail: Private-label range recognized in a national packaging design competition in 2023.

achievements.title: Guest lecturer
achievements.detail: Give an annual talk on packaging production to graphic design students at a Montréal CEGEP.
